name: couatl
lore:
Imagine soaring above the jungle canopy, the wind whispering through your rainbow-hued wings. You are a couatl, a celestial serpent of immense power and unyielding goodness. Your eyes pierce through illusion, seeing the truth that lies hidden beneath the surface, and your mind races with the accumulated wisdom of centuries. You are a guardian, a protector, a beacon of hope in a world shrouded in darkness.

As a couatl, you are driven by an insatiable thirst for knowledge and an unwavering commitment to justice. You seek out those who are lost and guide them towards the light, offering aid and protection to those who are in need. Your very presence radiates benevolence, inspiring courage and hope in the hearts of those you encounter. But be warned, for your path is not without peril. The forces of evil and chaos seek to corrupt and destroy all that you hold dear, and you must stand vigilant against their insidious influence.

But remember, your greatest strength lies not in your magical prowess or psionic abilities, but in your unwavering commitment to your principles. Your heart is your compass, guiding you towards the path of righteousness, and your spirit is your shield, protecting you from the corrupting influence of darkness. Embrace your destiny, and soar to new heights of glory, for the fate of the world may rest upon your feathered wings.
